A Better Smartphone, By
Design.

1
Consumer Problem
High Costs, Zero Control
Users pay premium prices for devices that track their habits and are hard to fix.
01
Unauthorized Tracking
Background code in everyday apps tracks consumer habits and sells access to advertisers.
3 out of 4 apps request access to personal data they do not need.
02
Wasted Consumer Capital
Phone companies charge premium prices for devices designed to become obsolete within a few years.
$500 billion is spent annually buying replacement devices while existing hardware still works.
03
Accelerating E-Waste
Unrepairable mobile hardware creates millions of tons of non-recyclable electronic garbage each year.
E-waste increases by 2.6M tonnes yearly, on track for 82 million tonnes by 2030.
04
Opaque, Unethical Supply Chains
You have no way of knowing if your phone was made ethically or at the expense of the earth.
Over 70% of global battery cobalt comes from regions linked to severe deforestation, water pollution, and hazardous labor conditions.
2
Business Problem
Corporate Security at Risk
How unmanaged mobile endpoints create corporate vulnerabilities.
01
Employee Device Data Leaks
When staff handle client work on personal phones, businesses lose visibility and take on real liability.
48% of organizations suffered a breach linked to unmanaged personal devices in 2025.
02
Compliance Exposure
Standard phones cannot prove who accessed sensitive company data during regulatory audits.
Average US corporate data breach costs $9.36M in total losses and regulatory fines.
03
Executive Targeting
Attackers actively target executives and key staff via mobile phishing to bypass internal corporate firewalls.
SIM swap fraud rose over 1,000% in 2024 year over year because mobile phishing has been increasingly personalized.
04
Insurance and Liability Surcharges
When a security incident occurs, insurance premiums spike significantly for companies that fail to manage mobile risks properly.
Companies face 25% to 50% cyber insurance premium hikes following a mobile-related security incident.

Built for People Who Want
More From Their Phone
Who It’s For
Target

The Solution
Data Protection OS
Lumé OS blocks background tracking and separates work and personal data from the start.
Simple Self Repair
Swap out components with basic tools rather than replacing the whole phone.
Solar Assisted Charging
Harvests energy from ambient light and body heat to extend daily battery performance.
Long Use Architecture
Modular design lets you upgrade key components over time instead of buying a new phone every two years.

8
Competitive Edge
Built Differently: Hard To Replicate
Replicating Cioré requires competitors to dismantle their own revenue models, while new entrants must build the authentic community trust we earn daily.
01
Unmatched System Integration
Our all in one approach creates a compound advantage that single feature competitors cannot replicate.
Hardware, OS, energy, and privacy layered into one ecosystem.
02
True OS Independence
Lumé OS stands apart by eliminating the built in data collection that traditional mobile ecosystems rely on.
Designed around user control, with revenue from devices, membership and upgrades.
03
Circular Hardware Model
Instead of relying on full device replacements, Cioré keeps customers engaged and buying again through easy hardware upgrades as technology advances.
Modular design extends device life and turns upgrades into recurring revenue.
04
Transparent Hardware Sourcing
Buyers want to know what their phone is made of, so Cioré provides clear material tracking that complex incumbent networks cannot easily offer.
Full supply chain visibility from raw material to finished device.
